subject: Intro: Dedicated capacity demo — StratusAI throughput intake
messages:
From: Aaron Bloom <aaron.bloom@stratusai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Hey Priyom,

We just spun up a few self-serve tests with Redwood and we like the latency profile so far. We want to pursue a short dedicated-capacity demo to understand how Reserved capacity would map to our peak traffic. Quick background: StratusAI runs a real-time summarization feature — typical requests are ~700 tokens input / 600 tokens output, and we peak around 180 RPS (concurrent inference requests) during batch windows; we also have occasional spikes to ~320 RPS.

Can you put us on the calendar for a Dedicated walkthrough with an engineer who can talk about throughput, KV cache behavior for repeated prefixes, and autoscaling options? I attached a one-pager with our baseline numbers. Prefer morning PST next week, but we're flexible.

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Bloom
Head of Engineering
StratusAI
Attachment: stratus_capacity_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Bloom <aaron.bloom@stratusai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Hi Aaron — thanks for the summary and the attachment, this is perfect context.

Quick plan: I want to loop in our AE (Marissa) and a Solutions Engineer (Monica) so we can walk through architecture + expected tail latency under sustained load. Marissa, Monica — are you available for a 45-minute slot next week to cover: 1) how reserved pools map to RPS and token throughput, 2) batching/cache knobs for repeated prefixes, and 3) autoscale / fallback policies?

Aaron — can you do any of these options (all PST):
- Tue 2026-12-01 09:30–10:15
- Wed 2026-12-02 10:00–10:45
- Thu 2026-12-03 08:30–09:15

If none work, paste a few windows and we'll accommodate. Also, if there's a specific SLA or cost target (e.g., 95th percentile latency < 150ms at 180 RPS), call it out so we can prep numbers.

Cheers,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Aaron Bloom <aaron.bloom@stratusai.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Thanks — Wed 2026-12-02 10:00 PST works best for us. A couple clarifications so Marissa/Monica can prep:
- 180 RPS sustained, typical payload ~1.3k tokens total; 320 RPS burst for ~3–5 minutes once per day.
- Target: p95 generation latency < 200ms if possible; if not, we want a plan that makes trade-offs explicit (e.g., quantization vs latency).
- We'd like to review cost estimates for reserved pools vs dynamic fallback to hosted.

Copying another engineering lead (Priya Rao) who will join.

Aaron
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Bloom <aaron.bloom@stratusai.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Thanks Aaron — Wed 12/02 10:00 PST is locked on our side. Monica and I will be the primary presenters; we'll plan for a 45-minute call plus 15 minutes for any deep-dive. Agenda: 1) intake review of your attached capacity sheet, 2) mapping to Reserved pool sizes + expected token/s cost, 3) tail latency scenarios and tuning, 4) autoscale & fallback routing.

Monica — can you prepare a short perf slide with p50/p95/p99 expectations across hypothetical pool sizes (we'll use Aaron's 180 nominal, 320 burst numbers)? Also, sending a Calendly invite now: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-dedicated-demo

See you Wed.

—Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@stratusai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aaron Bloom <aaron.bloom@stratusai.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Hi all — apologies, last-minute calendar conflict on my side (executive review moved up). Can we move the demo 1 hour later on Wed to 11:00–11:45 PST? The rest of the Stratus team is ok with the shift. If that doesn't work for Redwood, we can do Thu 12/03 08:30–09:15 as a backup.

Thanks,
Priya
Engineering Lead, StratusAI
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@stratusai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Interested in Dedicated — throughput questions

Hi Priya — thanks for the heads up. Marissa and Monica are available at 11:00–11:45 PST on Wed 12/02; I've updated the calendar invite and attached the intake worksheet to the event.

Call details: Zoom link + Teams dial-in (in calendar). Agenda unchanged.

I'll also drop a short prep note to Aaron with the specific perf counters Monica will present so you know what to expect. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom
SDR, Redwood Inference
